usedFor: Zenventory holds inventory and orders, and Calendly makes booking links through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Order” in Zenventory, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new customer order gets a booking link, so the customer can pick a time.

watchOut: “New Customer Order” in Zenventory is polling, so the link is made after a scheduled check.
